general.name: General system checks
general.description: Repeatable software checks for your own application or service. Connect your test adapters; keep a report for the exact release.
general.basis: Forge-authored procedures; your adapters define the assertions.

checks.title: Identify the exact release
checks.procedure: Record your system name, version and full source commit.

checks.title: Verify release files
checks.procedure: Compare release files with independently recorded SHA-256 values.

checks.title: Start and exercise the application
checks.procedure: Start the selected build in a disposable environment and assert a benign workflow succeeds.

checks.title: Close, reopen and preserve data
checks.procedure: Exercise close/reopen and confirm saved data survives in the same release.

checks.title: Reject malformed inputs
checks.procedure: Submit invalid inputs to your isolated application and assert they are rejected.

checks.title: Recover after interruption
checks.procedure: Interrupt a disposable software connection and assert the documented recovery behavior.

checks.title: Restore a saved backup
checks.procedure: Restore a test backup and verify its data in an isolated workspace.

checks.title: Enforce access boundaries
checks.procedure: Assert an unauthorized test identity cannot perform restricted operations.

checks.title: Review usability and accessibility
checks.procedure: Have a reviewer exercise the documented workflow, keyboard controls and narrow-screen presentation; record unresolved defects.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet III preparation
gauntlet.description: General checks plus a limited, source-bound document inventory for DDP Phase 3. Document hashes verify bytes; reviewers decide what those documents establish.
gauntlet.basis: DDP Phase 3 RFS Rev3 and DDPSCF v2; a preparation subset, not the official event test suite.

checks.title: Pin the reviewed RFS copy
checks.procedure: Retain the reviewed Phase 3 RFS Rev3 bytes; recheck official revisions before use.

checks.title: Retain the operator manual
checks.procedure: Inventory a version-matched operator guide for human review.

checks.title: Retain the maintenance package
checks.procedure: Inventory maintenance and change documentation for reviewer assessment.

checks.title: Retain supplier evidence
checks.procedure: Inventory component and supplier records for the applicable phase.

checks.title: Retain repository provenance
checks.procedure: Inventory source-hosting and administration evidence for assessment.

checks.title: Assess the documentation
checks.procedure: Compare document contents and scope against the selected RFS and framework with a qualified reviewer.

checks.title: Obtain external acceptance
checks.procedure: Official program, supplier and physical acceptance require their own assessors and evidence. This runner cannot close them.

dow.name: DoW software assurance preparation
dow.description: General checks plus selected software-development evidence practices. Your contract determines applicable obligations; this profile does not cover every DoW requirement.
dow.basis: Selected NIST SSDF 1.1 practices. Applicability and organizational assessments require separate review.

checks.title: Map applicable requirements
checks.procedure: Inventory a requirements-to-evidence mapping.

checks.title: Inventory software dependencies
checks.procedure: Retain your component inventory for assessment.

checks.title: Retain source and build provenance
checks.procedure: Retain provenance and repository access-control evidence.

checks.title: Run dependency vulnerability checks
checks.procedure: Run your dependency-policy adapter and assert findings meet your selected policy.

checks.title: Exercise software security tests
checks.procedure: Run your isolated security regression adapter.

checks.title: Retain remediation decisions
checks.procedure: Inventory defect decisions and remediation records for assessment.

checks.title: Assess contract and organization scope
checks.procedure: Have the responsible assessor determine applicable contract, CMMC and organizational obligations. Software test output cannot certify them.
